Security Free Watch Video Feature Overview Datadog Cloud Security uses an agentless technology within your cloud to scan your entire infrastructure in minutes for vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, identity risks, and compliance violations. In addition, Datadog’s lightweight, open-source agent gives Security and DevOps teams more granular and timely visibility into active risks that can be fixed in a few clicks. Tightly integrated in a unified platform with live observability data and attack activity, Cloud Security allows you to detect, prioritize, and fix security issues faster and more effectively to continuously improve your security posture.
